title: JPCERT/CC: Security Alert: Microsoft Releases November 2026 Security Updates
CERT-EU: 2026-020: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
summary: On 12 November 2026, the Cloud Software Group published security bulletins for its Citrix products addressing 28 memory flaws in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. One of these vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-120868, affects every deployment, including those using the default configuration
